description: List the R3 factories available to r3_factory_run, with each one's options, types and defaults. A factory builds a complete, correctly-wired object — a cube is a mesh plus geometry plus material plus colour, already connected. Call this before r3_factory_run if you are unsure of a factory name or its options.

factory.description: Optional: return only this factory, e.g. "Cube". Omit for all of them.

name: r3_factory_list
title: List what can be built in R3
